title: Take-up Rate for Paid Paternity Leave
what_it_is: Take-up Rate for Paid Paternity Leave

sections.label: Paternity leave numbers and claims
sections.summary: In 2014 and 2015 the numbers were 11,900 and 12,300, and fathers of babies born on or after 1 January 2015 can claim an additional week of paternity leave, with employer claims from mid-2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: In 2014 and 2015, the numbers were 11,900 and 12,300 respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: With the employers' agreement, fathers of babies born on or after 1 January 2015 can claim an additional week of paternity leave.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Employers will be able to submit their claims from mid-2016 after changes to the IT system and processes are completed.

sections.label: GPPL take-up rates
sections.summary: About 28% of fathers took up the GPPL in 2013, about 36% in 2014 and 25% in 2015, and the 2015 figures will increase because the electronic system is not fully up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: In 2013, about 28% of fathers took up the GPPL; in 2014, it was about 36% and, in 2015, 25%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: For the 2015 figures, it will increase because the electronic system is not fully up, so the submissions are still coming in.

sections.label: Voluntary employer leave and fathers
sections.summary: Granting that leave is voluntary for employers, the Government supports it, and it encourages fathers to take a more active role in parenting with VWOs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: At this point in time, this is on a voluntary basis for employers whether to grant or not grant that leave.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Actually, I should go and check up on what the figures are on the Government front but certainly, the Government supports this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The whole role of parents, especially fathers, is something that we are quite particular about.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We do encourage and we are working with the various VWOs to encourage fathers to take up a more active role in parenting.
